caption: William Birch, The Sun Reflecting on the Dew, a Garden Scene (c. 1812), etching: “Echo, Pennsylv.ª a place belonging to Mr. D. Bavarage”
alt: A small etching of a wooded garden at sunrise: tall slender trees and pale boulders, a stream tumbling over rocks at the left, and light breaking through the leaves behind. Engraved below: The Sun reflecting on the Dew, a Garden scene.
bibliography: Birch, William. The Sun Reflecting on the Dew, a Garden Scene. c. 1812, etching, Art Institute of Chicago, 2013.771.
title: Sun Reflecting on the Dew, A Garden Scene
